protocol: rtsp/onvif camera, recorded as JPEG frames + timestamp manifest
replay: go run ./cmd/synth replay cctv            # MJPEG over HTTP at http://localhost:8086/<camera_id>
notes: frames/*.jpg are generated by `bundle`, not committed; the replayer serves them as MJPEG over HTTP (multipart/x-mixed-replace) in pts order. trailer_id is ground truth burned into the frame, not something the camera reports
